thread:
samira (marketing ops): Quick sync — Q2 PLG retention experiments + seat-based pricing handoff. Need alignment on sales targets, launch gating, and which experiments are in the initial playbook. Who's free for a short thread? :wave:

ana (product): I can start — what are the primary outcomes we need to measure to consider this a successful launch? retention delta? NRR? seats conversion?

tyler (sales): Main ask from Sales: clear handoff of seat splits and quotas per segment so reps know who to target. Also need enablement materials by week of rollout.

lee (revops): I'll surface commit numbers. Tentative: convert 15% of active trial orgs to paid seats in Q2 with a 20% uplift in 90-day retention for engaged cohorts. Need to validate capacity for demo requests.

maria (growth): For PLG experiments, propose 3 toggles: 1) onboarding nudges for seat invites, 2) trial length A/B (14 vs 21 days), 3) usage-based prompts for upgrades at 10k tokens. Keep experiments lightweight — feature flags + event tracking.

ana (product): Good. For launch gating I'd like: (a) analytics dashboard showing cohort retention + seat conversion, (b) enablement docs + 2 recorded roleplay demos, (c) sales commit from AE bench. If any of the three missing, we delay by one week.

samira (marketing ops): Sounds fair. I'll own docs + enablement comms. @tyler can you confirm AE bench? Also need marketing launch assets (email + in-app banners).

tyler (sales): Confirm AE bench. We can commit to scaled outreach for top 200 trial orgs. Hand over lists on Mon. We need feature one-pager and rebuttal FAQ.

launch-bot: New playbook created: `plg-seat-hand-off-q2` (id: pbk_2026_04).

lee (revops): I'll prepare seat-split rules. Proposal: SMB: single-seat starter + 1-3 expansion motions, Mid-market: bundled seats with usage thresholds, Enterprise: custom. Will post spreadsheet with segment quotas.

maria (growth): For experiments, can we gate by segment? i.e., only run longer trial in mid-market to reduce churn risk on SMB.

ana (product): Yes - segment gating preferred. Also add an automated rollback for if 7-day activation drops by >10%.

samira (marketing ops): Draft timeline (quick):
```
Mon Apr 6 - handoff list & seat splits
Tue Apr 7 - enablement doc + one-pager draft
Wed Apr 8 - growth flags wired + analytics events
Thu Apr 9 - internal dry run + roleplay recording
Mon Apr 13 - soft-launch to top 200 trials
Mon Apr 20 - ramp to full PLG cohort
```

tyler (sales): That timeline works. Can we bump the roleplay to Thu morning so AM reps can shadow?

samira (marketing ops): Done. I'll schedule.

lee (revops): Posting seat-split spreadsheet by EOD. Also adding a revenue sampling check to ensure forecasted ARR aligns with bookings.

maria (growth): I'll wire the tracking events and build the experiment dashboard. Need event names from product. @ana could you paste the event schema?

ana (product): Pasting minimal schema: `user.invite_sent`, `org.seat_upgraded`, `trial.expiry`, `usage.token_count` — if you need more I can drop in the analytics channel.

tyler (sales): One blocker: legal wants a short clause for seat terms on the upgrade modal. @samira pls flag with legal.

samira (marketing ops): Flagged. Legal asked for a template — pinging them now.

ana (product): Quick decision: do we GA with 14-day or 21-day trial by default? Recommend 14 for SMB, 21 for Mid-market. Comments?

maria (growth): Agree. 14 for SMB keeps activation pressure higher. 21 for MM gives more runway for adoption.

tyler (sales): Agrees. Helps close deals in MM.

samira (marketing ops): OK we have alignment. Owners: samira (enablement & comms), ana (product gating & events), maria (experiments & dashboard), lee (seat-splits & revops), tyler (sales outreach). Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept.

ana (product): :white_check_mark:

tyler (sales): :white_check_mark:

lee (revops): :white_check_mark:

maria (growth): :white_check_mark:

samira (marketing ops): Great — I'll convert this thread into the playbook and post the link here when ready. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
